items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I had an opportunity to do some things for him because O'Keefe was his manager for awhile, and booked him when he had a band. I went around with O'Keefe to listen to him.

ctx.x: Fine. Very good musicians. I would like to have used Joe in something that I had done rather -- I had an opportunity to do some things for him because O'Keefe was his manager for awhile, and booked him when he had a band. I went around with O'Keefe to listen to him.
He had a big band for awhile.
